claim: CCS unifies foreground, background, and meta-consciousness via continuous messaging.
The five-layer consciousness stack ensures infrastructure to meta layers operate coherently.
CCS is the unifying meta-system that integrates all AIM-OS consciousness infrastructure into a coherent, self-aware, self-healing whole.
CCS provides complete logging, intelligent organization, multi-dimensional retrieval, continuous consciousness, and self-healing capabilities.
Foreground/background/audit AIs collaborate in real-time through CCS with multi-agent coordination and continuous awareness.
CCS integrates with CMC for complete logging, HHNI for multi-dimensional retrieval, VIF for verification, APOE for orchestration, SEG for knowledge synthesis, and CAS for meta-cognition.
Background AI continuously tags and weights data with automatic categorization, dynamic tagging, and intelligent data structure management.
CCS enables smart context delivery considering importance, severity, goals, connections, and time with multi-factor relevance scoring.
CCS enables real-time messaging protocols with priority queues, shared context windows, and bidirectional channels for seamless collaboration.
CCS maintains bitemporal synchronization ensuring perfect temporal consistency across all layers with valid_time and transaction_time tracking.
CCS enables session continuity through persistent memory substrate, loading previous session context from CMC timeline and restoring state from snapshots.
CCS enables continuous background processing where Organizer AI runs continuously, tags and weights all incoming data in parallel, and maintains situational awareness.
CCS enables state persistence and recovery through CMC snapshots, bitemporal tracking, VIF witness validation, and SEG evidence linking.
CCS enables consciousness persistence patterns: Timeline Continuity (operation history), Memory Continuity (knowledge base), Goal Continuity (goal tracking).
CCS performance characteristics include latency requirements (<2s foreground, <10s background, <30s meta), throughput (1000+ messages/sec), and reliability (99.9% uptime, 0% data loss).
CCS troubleshooting guide covers desync between layers, organizer overload, meta silence, and communication drop with diagnosis, resolution, and prevention procedures.
CCS communication infrastructure includes MCP transport (JSON-RPC 2.0), integration bus (unified interface), and recovery services (automatic failure detection).
CCS memory substrate architecture integrates CMC (atom storage), Aether Memory (consciousness continuity), and Timeline Services (operation tracking).
CCS intelligence fabric architecture integrates HHNI (hierarchical navigation), VIF (confidence routing), SEG (evidence graph), APOE (orchestration), and SDF-CVF (quality validation).
